sloka: ते ऽतिकायं समासाद्य वानरा मूढचेतसः।शरण्यं शरणं जग्मुर्लक्ष्मणाग्रजमाहवे ।। ६.७१.९ ।।
transliteration: te 'tikāyaṁ samāsādya vānarā mūḍhacetasaḥ।śaraṇyaṁ śaraṇaṁ jagmurlakṣmaṇāgrajamāhave ।। 6.71.9 ।।

translations.english: The Vanaras were deluded on reaching the huge body and went to Sri Rama to seek refuge.
